text: Starting from an existing model's definition is the recommended authoring path: `ollama show --modelfile <model>` prints its Modelfile including TEMPLATE and parameters. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: Template syntax is model-specific: copying another model's TEMPLATE breaks output, and after replacing TEMPLATE the stop parameters must be reset to that model's special tokens. SYSTEM only takes effect if the TEMPLATE contains a .System block. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: TEMPLATE uses Go text/template syntax; documented variables are {{ .System }}, {{ .Prompt }} and {{ .Response }}, and text after {{ .Response }} is omitted when generating. The reference page does not document .Messages, .Tools or .Think. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: Only FROM is required in a Modelfile; PARAMETER, TEMPLATE, SYSTEM, ADAPTER, LICENSE, MESSAGE and REQUIRES are optional. Instructions are case-insensitive and may appear in any order. (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: FROM accepts an existing library model (name:tag), a safetensors model directory, or a GGUF file path (absolute or relative to the Modelfile). Split GGUF is supported with a wildcard (FROM ./model-*.gguf) or one FROM line per shard. (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: Documented PARAMETER defaults on the Modelfile reference: num_ctx 2048, temperature 0.8, seed 0, top_k 40, top_p 0.9, min_p 0.0, repeat_last_n 64 (0 disabled, -1 = num_ctx), num_predict -1 (infinite). stop has no default and is repeated once per pattern. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: MESSAGE <role> <text> seeds conversation history; valid roles are system, user and assistant, and repeating it builds a few-shot example conversation. MESSAGE system is an alternative to SYSTEM. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: SYSTEM and LICENSE take triple-quoted text (SYSTEM """..."""). LICENSE records license text in the model; the build/run commands are `ollama create <name> -f ./Modelfile` then `ollama run <name>`. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: REQUIRES <version> sets the minimum Ollama version (example 0.14.0), and a CAPABILITY instruction adds capabilities to GGUF/MLX models; the reference page also lists a draft_num_predict parameter (4 for separate draft models, 0 disables speculative drafting). These are recent additions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: ADAPTER points at a LoRA adapter (GGUF or safetensors) and requires FROM to name the base model the adapter was tuned on; a mismatched base gives unstable behavior. The official Modelfile reference page fetched here has no ADAPTER section, and the import page does not cover it. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE

text: The Modelfile reference documents num_ctx default 2048, while the Ollama FAQ says the default context window is 4096 tokens. OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH overrides the server default; per-request num_ctx goes in the API options object, and PARAMETER num_ctx bakes it into a model. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama Modelfile authoring: FROM and PARAMETER and TEMPLATE and SYSTEM and ADAPTER and MESSAGE and LICENSE
